body.en:
Question B-007-002-008.

Why the correct answer is right: F2 is highest, so a refracted wave can cover a longer ground distance before returning. That geometry makes it central to the longest ordinary HF paths.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "Because it exists only at night": Because it exists only at night is false; F2 is especially named as the upper daytime F sub-region and remains important in many conditions.
- sourceIndex 2: "Because it is the lowest ionospheric region": Because it is the lowest ionospheric region reverses the layer order; the D region is lowest.
- sourceIndex 3: "Because it does not absorb radio waves as much as other ionospheric regions": Because it does not absorb radio waves as much as other ionospheric regions mentions a helpful trait, but the longest-distance reason tested is its high altitude.
